comment: Task 4.3 — the standing event->role wiring table (ratified 2026-07-19). 'standing' means WIRED HERE, not honour-system prose. Two wire kinds: check = a script event-fire runs immediately; summon = an instruction line event-fire emits for the session lead (role + runbook), consumed by the hook/orchestrator. Removing a wire makes the event fire nothing for that role (the firing tests assert this) and event-wiring-check flags uncovered ratified events.

release-composed.why: standing quality pass on every composed release

feature-build-starts.why: dispatch-on-match: web features (mobile routes to the mobile role)
